conclusion.bound: For n nonzero secured edges, sum-floor deficit at most n-1 micro-USDC per default (n<=32); repeated defaults can accumulate. No bound on uncollected interest implied by principal collateral.

After minimum one-day term + 30-day late period, stake holders cannot gain principal by resetting wallet but lender may earn zero interest while cash is delayed.

mainnet_gates: CI30 must be fixed on the actual selected deployment and regression-tested; old deployment cannot become safe through workflow instructions.
Independent customer acceptance and externally funded settlement must be proven off chain; fake customer wallets or circular payments do not qualify.
Actual secured backing must cover principal without grant-first surprises; model dust and timing costs.
Issuer approvals cap cumulative exposure plus unrecovered losses, with beneficial-owner controls, not just active on-chain budgets.
Measured fees, realistic failure/dispute/delivery costs and noncredit alternatives determine positive net borrower surplus.
Simulations can falsify unsafe policies, not establish real independent customer demand or authorize mainnet migration.
